summary: Collaboration AI Engineer position for a 12-month contract with hybrid work arrangement. The ideal candidate will have experience in Power Platform, SharePoint development, and administration.
responsibilities: Assist in designing, developing, and deploying solutions using Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages).
Support the customization and maintenance of SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, and workflows.
Contribute to PowerShell scripting activities for automation, configuration, and maintenance tasks.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Power Platform and SharePoint, escalating complex problems as needed.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Participate in documentation efforts, including user guides and technical documentation.
Receive mentorship from senior engineers and actively contribute to team projects.
Assist in scoping and business analysis activities for collaboration solutions.
required_skills: experience in Power Platform and SharePoint development or administration
Basic proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and administration tasks
Familiarity with SharePoint Online and Teams
Understanding of Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power Pages, Copilot
qualifications: Experience with Sharepoint, Power Platform and Copilot.
Familiarity with Microsoft Graph and REST APIs
Microsoft certifications in SharePoint, Power Platform, or Azure.
